ko.title: TSMC 이번 주 실적 발표: 대만 반도체 제조업체가 AI 열풍의 전광판인 이유

segments.src: Few corporate earnings reports are read as closely outside their own industry as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.
segments.tr: 대만 위탁생산 반도체업체인 TSMC(Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.)만큼 자체 업계를 넘어 광범위하게 주목받는 기업 실적 보고서는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: (TSMC).
segments.tr: (TSMC).

segments.src: The company makes the advanced processors that power many of the world's largest AI data centers, which makes its quarterly results one of the most useful windows into whether AI spending is still speeding up, leveling off, or cooling.
segments.tr: 이 회사는 세계 최대 AI 데이터 센터 다수에 동력을 공급하는 첨단 프로세서를 제조하며, 이로 인해 이 회사의 분기 실적은 AI 지출이 여전히 가속화되고 있는지, 정체되고 있는지, 아니면 식어가고 있는지를 보여주는 가장 유용한 창 중 하나가 됩니다.

segments.src: This week's report arrives after several weeks of choppy trading in technology stocks.
segments.tr: 이번 주 실적 발표는 기술주 거래가 수주간 변동성을 보인 이후에 이루어집니다.

segments.src: Here is what to look for, and why it matters beyond a single company.
segments.tr: 단일 기업을 넘어 주목해야 할 점과 이것이 중요한 이유를 정리했습니다.

segments.src: ## Why TSMC sits at the center of the AI story
segments.tr: ## TSMC가 AI 스토리의 중심에 서 있는 이유

segments.src: TSMC is a *foundry*: it manufactures chips designed by other companies rather than selling chips under its own brand.
segments.tr: TSMC는 *파운드리*: 자체 브랜드로 칩을 판매하기보다 다른 기업이 설계한 칩을 위탁 제조합니다.

segments.src: Many of the leading designers of AI accelerators, data center processors and smartphone chips rely on it to turn their designs into silicon, particularly at the most advanced manufacturing nodes.
segments.tr: AI 가속기, 데이터 센터 프로세서, 스마트폰 칩을 설계하는 수많은 선도 기업들이 특히 가장 최첨단 제조 공정 노드에서 그들의 설계를 실리콘으로 구현하기 위해 TSMC에 의존하고 있습니다.

segments.src: That position creates an unusual vantage point.
segments.tr: 이러한 위치는 독특한 관점을 제공합니다.

segments.src: When cloud providers and AI developers plan to buy more computing power, the orders eventually flow down the supply chain to the factories that build the chips.
segments.tr: 클라우드 제공업체와 AI 개발자가 더 많은 연산 능력을 구매하려고 계획할 때, 주문은 결국 공급망을 따라 칩을 만드는 공장으로 이어집니다.

segments.src: TSMC sees that demand before it shows up in many customers' own financial statements.
segments.tr: TSMC는 이러한 수요가 많은 고객사의 자체 재무제표에 나타나기 전에 먼저 파악합니다.

segments.src: In other words, the company works as a kind of scoreboard.
segments.tr: 다시 말해, 이 회사는 일종의 점수판 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: It does not pick winners among AI software firms or chip designers, but it reflects how much total capacity the industry is trying to build.
segments.tr: AI 소프트웨어 기업이나 칩 설계업체 중에서 승자를 골라내지는 않지만, 이 업계가 얼마나 전체적인 총 용량을 구축하려 하는지 반영합니다.

segments.src: ## What investors and analysts will be watching
segments.tr: ## 투자자와 분석가들이 주목할 요소

segments.src: ### 1. Revenue mix: AI versus everything else
segments.tr: ### 1. 매출 비중: AI 대 기타 영역

segments.src: TSMC breaks out revenue by platform, including high-performance computing, smartphones, automotive and Internet of Things.
segments.tr: TSMC는 고성능 컴퓨팅, 스마트폰, 자동차, 사물인터넷(IoT)을 포함한 플랫폼별로 매출을 세분화하여 공개합니다.

segments.src: The high-performance computing category is the one most closely tied to AI.
segments.tr: 고성능 컴퓨팅 카테고리가 AI와 가장 밀접하게 연결되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts will watch how fast it is growing, and whether it keeps taking a larger share of the total.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 이 부문이 얼마나 빠르게 성장하고 있는지, 그리고 전체에서 차지하는 비중이 계속 확대되고 있는지 살필 것입니다.

segments.src: ### 2. Guidance for the next quarter
segments.tr: ### 2. 다음 분기 실적 가이던스

segments.src: Results describe the past; guidance describes what management expects next.
segments.tr: 실적은 과거를 설명하지만, 가이던스는 경영진이 향후 기대하는 바를 설명합니다.

segments.src: A forward revenue range and margin outlook often move markets more than the quarter that just ended.
segments.tr: 향후 매출 전망치와 마진 전망은 방금 끝난 분기 실적보다 시장을 더 크게 움직이곤 합니다.

segments.src: A confident outlook suggests customers are still placing firm orders, while a cautious tone could signal that buyers are digesting earlier purchases.
segments.tr: 자신감 있는 전망은 고객사들이 여전히 확실한 주문을 넣고 있음을 시사하는 반면, 신중한 어조는 구매자들이 이전 구매 물량을 소화하고 있다는 신호일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 3. Capital spending plans
segments.tr: ### 3. 설비 투자(CapEx) 계획

segments.src: TSMC spends heavily on new factories and equipment, and its capital expenditure plans are a bet on future demand.
segments.tr: TSMC는 신규 공장과 장비에 막대한 금액을 지출하며, 설비 투자 계획은 미래 수요에 대한 베팅입니다.

segments.src: Raising the budget implies management sees durable growth.
segments.tr: 예산을 늘리는 것은 경영진이 지속 가능한 성장을 내다보고 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Trimming it would be read as a sign of caution.
segments.tr: 예산을 축소하는 것은 신중함의 신호로 해석될 것입니다.

segments.src: Either way, the change also ripples through equipment makers and other suppliers.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽이든 이 변화는 장비 제조업체와 기타 공급업체에도 파급 효과를 미칩니다.

segments.src: ### 4. Advanced packaging capacity
segments.tr: ### 4. 첨단 패키징 용량

segments.src: For AI chips, the bottleneck has not been only the silicon itself.
segments.tr: AI 칩의 병목 현상은 실리콘 자체에만 국한되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Advanced packaging, the process of combining processors and high-bandwidth memory into a single module, has been a limiting factor.
segments.tr: 프로세서와 고대역폭 메모리를 단일 모듈로 결합하는 공정인 첨단 패키징이 제약 요인이 되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: Commentary on how quickly that capacity is expanding helps explain how much supply can reach the market.
segments.tr: 해당 용량이 얼마나 빠르게 확장되고 있는지에 대한 언급은 얼마나 많은 공급량이 시장에 도달할 수 있는지 설명하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: ### 5. Margins and costs
segments.tr: ### 3. 마진과 비용

segments.src: Building cutting-edge factories is expensive, and overseas expansion adds cost.
segments.tr: 최첨단 공장을 짓는 데는 막대한 비용이 들며, 해외 확장 역시 비용을 가중시킵니다.

segments.src: Gross margin trends show whether TSMC can maintain pricing strength while absorbing those expenses, as well as the effect of currency movements, since it reports in Taiwan dollars while many of its sales are priced in U.S.
segments.tr: 매출 상당 부분이 U.S. 달러로 책정되는 반면 실적은 대만 달러로 보고하므로, 매출총이익률 추이는 TSMC가 이러한 비용과 환율 변동의 영향을 흡수하면서 가격 결정력을 유지할 수 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: dollars.
## Reading the results in context
segments.tr: ## 맥락 속에서 실적 해석하기

segments.src: After a period of sharp swings on Wall Street, a single report will not settle the debate over whether AI spending is sustainable.
segments.tr: 월가의 급격한 변동성을 겪은 후, 단 하나의 실적 보고서로 AI 지출의 지속 가능성에 대한 논쟁이 끝나지는 않을 것입니다.

segments.src: Still, it can supply useful evidence for several questions:
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 몇 가지 질문에 대한 유용한 증거를 제공할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Is demand broad or narrow?** Strength concentrated in a few customers carries different implications than growth spread across many.
segments.tr: - **수요가 광범위한가, 아니면 협소한가?** 일부 고객에게 집중된 강세는 다수의 고객에게 분산된 성장과 다른 의미를 갖습니다.

segments.src: - **Is supply catching up?** If capacity is expanding fast enough, the shortage that supported pricing may ease.
segments.tr: - **공급이 수요를 따라잡고 있는가?** 생산 능력이 충분히 빠르게 확장된다면 가격을 뒷받침했던 공급 부족이 완화될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Is spending turning into revenue downstream?** TSMC's customers ultimately need end users and businesses willing to pay for AI services. Chip orders are only sustainable if that demand materializes.
segments.tr: - **지출이 다운스트림에서 매출로 이어지고 있는가?** TSMC의 고객사는 궁극적으로 AI 서비스에 기꺼이 비용을 지불할 최종 사용자 및 기업이 필요합니다. 칩 주문은 이러한 수요가 실현되어야만 지속 가능합니다.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering the limits of the signal.
segments.tr: 이 신호의 한계점을 기억하는 것도 중요합니다.

segments.src: Foundry orders can run ahead of actual consumption, and customers sometimes build inventory.
segments.tr: 파운드리 주문은 실제 소비보다 앞설 수 있으며, 고객사들이 때때로 재고를 축적하기도 합니다.

segments.src: A strong quarter does not guarantee the following one, and a soft guide does not necessarily mean a trend has reversed.
segments.tr: 강력한 분기 실적이 다음 분기를 보장하지 않으며, 신중한 가이던스가 반드시 추세가 반전되었음을 의미하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: ## Risks that sit outside the income statement
segments.tr: ## 손익계산서 외적인 위험 요소

segments.src: Several factors beyond quarterly numbers shape how the market interprets the company:
segments.tr: 분기별 숫자 외에도 몇 가지 요인이 시장이 이 기업을 해석하는 방식을 형성합니다:

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Taiwan's location and the strategic importance of chips mean trade policy, export controls and regional tensions are constant background risks.
segments.tr: - **지정학:** 대만의 위치와 반도체의 전략적 중요성으로 인해 무역 정책, 수출 규제 및 지역적 긴장은 상존하는 배경 위험입니다.

segments.src: - **Concentration:** The industry depends on a small number of suppliers for its most advanced chips, which makes disruptions especially consequential.
segments.tr: - **집중도:** 업계가 가장 첨단인 칩을 소수의 공급업체에 의존하고 있어, 차질이 생길 경우 그 여파가 특히 큽니다.

segments.src: - **Valuation:** When expectations are high, even good results can be met with selling if they fall short of the most optimistic forecasts.
segments.tr: - **밸류에이션:** 기대치가 높을 때는 좋은 실적을 내더라도 가장 낙관적인 전망에 미치지 못하면 매도세로 이어질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The takeaway
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: TSMC's report is not a verdict on every company riding the AI wave, but it is among the most direct readings of how much real manufacturing activity sits behind the headlines.
segments.tr: TSMC의 보고서가 AI 열풍에 올라탄 모든 기업에 대한 최종 판결은 아니지만, 헤드라인 뒤에 얼마나 많은 실제 제조업 활동이 존재는 지를 가장 직접적으로 보여주는 지표 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Pay attention to the guidance, the capital spending outlook and the language around demand and capacity.
segments.tr: 가이던스, 설비 투자 전망, 그리고 수요와 생산 능력에 관한 어조에 주목하십시오.

segments.src: Together they offer a grounded view of whether the AI buildout is still gathering pace.
segments.tr: 이 요소들은 함께 AI 구축이 여전히 속도를 내고 있는지에 대한 객관적인 시각을 제공합니다.

segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 투자 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Market conditions and company results can change quickly; consult official company filings and a qualified professional before making financial decisions.*
segments.tr: 시장 상황과 기업 실적은 빠르게 변할 수 있으므로 금융 결정을 내리기 전에 공식 기업 공시와 자격을 갖춘 전문가의 조언을 확인하십시오.*

segments.src: (TSMC).
segments.tr: （台积电）。

segments.tr: 该公司制造的先进处理器为全球许多大型人工智能数据中心提供动力，这使得其季度业绩成为判断人工智能支出是在加速、趋平还是降温的最有用的窗口之一。

segments.tr: 以下是需要关注的重点，以及为什么它对单一公司以外的领域也至关重要。

segments.src: ## Why TSMC sits at the center of the AI story
segments.tr: ## 为什么台积电处于人工智能故事的中心

segments.src: TSMC is a *foundry*: it manufactures chips designed by other companies rather than selling chips under its own brand.
segments.tr: 台积电是一家*晶圆代工厂*：它制造其他公司设计的芯片，而不是以自己的品牌销售芯片。

segments.src: Many of the leading designers of AI accelerators, data center processors and smartphone chips rely on it to turn their designs into silicon, particularly at the most advanced manufacturing nodes.
segments.tr: 许多领先的人工智能加速器、数据中心处理器和智能手机芯片设计商都依赖它将设计转化为硅片，特别是在最先进的制造节点上。

segments.src: That position creates an unusual vantage point.
segments.tr: 这种地位创造了一个独特的视角。

segments.src: When cloud providers and AI developers plan to buy more computing power, the orders eventually flow down the supply chain to the factories that build the chips.
segments.tr: 当云服务提供商和人工智能开发商计划购买更多计算能力时，订单最终会流向供应链下游，到达制造芯片的工厂。

segments.src: TSMC sees that demand before it shows up in many customers' own financial statements.
segments.tr: 台积电在许多客户自己的财务报表中体现出这些需求之前，就能先看到这些需求。

segments.src: In other words, the company works as a kind of scoreboard.
segments.tr: 换句话说，该公司充当了一种记分牌的角色。

segments.src: It does not pick winners among AI software firms or chip designers, but it reflects how much total capacity the industry is trying to build.
segments.tr: 它不会在人工智能软件公司或芯片设计商之间挑选赢家，但它反映了整个行业正在试图建立的总产能。

segments.src: ## What investors and analysts will be watching
segments.tr: ## 投资者和分析师将关注什么

segments.src: ### 1. Revenue mix: AI versus everything else
segments.tr: ### 1. 收入构成：人工智能与其他业务

segments.src: TSMC breaks out revenue by platform, including high-performance computing, smartphones, automotive and Internet of Things.
segments.tr: 台积电按平台划分收入，包括高性能计算、智能手机、汽车和物联网。

segments.src: The high-performance computing category is the one most closely tied to AI.
segments.tr: 高性能计算类别是与人工智能联系最紧密的类别。

segments.src: Analysts will watch how fast it is growing, and whether it keeps taking a larger share of the total.
segments.tr: 分析师将观察其增长速度，以及它是否继续在总收入中占据更大的份额。

segments.src: ### 2. Guidance for the next quarter
segments.tr: ### 2. 下一季度的业绩指引

segments.src: Results describe the past; guidance describes what management expects next.
segments.tr: 业绩描述的是过去；指引描述的是管理层对未来的预期。

segments.src: A forward revenue range and margin outlook often move markets more than the quarter that just ended.
segments.tr: 前瞻性的收入区间和利润率展望往往比刚刚结束的季度更能推动市场。

segments.src: A confident outlook suggests customers are still placing firm orders, while a cautious tone could signal that buyers are digesting earlier purchases.
segments.tr: 自信的展望表明客户仍在下达确定订单，而谨慎的基调可能预示着买家正在消化之前的采购。

segments.src: ### 3. Capital spending plans
segments.tr: ### 3. 资本支出计划

segments.src: TSMC spends heavily on new factories and equipment, and its capital expenditure plans are a bet on future demand.
segments.tr: 台积电在新工厂和设备上投入巨资，其资本支出计划是对未来需求的押注。

segments.src: Raising the budget implies management sees durable growth.
segments.tr: 提高预算意味着管理层看到了持久的增长。

segments.src: Trimming it would be read as a sign of caution.
segments.tr: 削减预算将被解读为谨慎的信号。

segments.src: Either way, the change also ripples through equipment makers and other suppliers.
segments.tr: 无论哪种方式，这种变化也会波及设备制造商和其他供应商。

segments.src: ### 4. Advanced packaging capacity
segments.tr: ### 4. 先进封装产能

segments.src: For AI chips, the bottleneck has not been only the silicon itself.
segments.tr: 对于人工智能芯片而言，瓶颈不仅仅在于硅片本身。

segments.src: Advanced packaging, the process of combining processors and high-bandwidth memory into a single module, has been a limiting factor.
segments.tr: 先进封装（将处理器和高带宽内存组合成单个模块的过程）一直是一个限制因素。

segments.src: Commentary on how quickly that capacity is expanding helps explain how much supply can reach the market.

segments.src: ## Reading the results in context
segments.tr: ## 在背景中解读业绩

segments.src: - **Is spending turning into revenue downstream?** TSMC's customers ultimately need end users and businesses willing to pay for AI services. Chip orders are only sustainable if that demand materializes.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering the limits of the signal.

segments.src: A strong quarter does not guarantee the following one, and a soft guide does not necessarily mean a trend has reversed.

segments.src: ## Risks that sit outside the income statement
segments.tr: ## 损益表之外的风险

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Taiwan's location and the strategic importance of chips mean trade policy, export controls and regional tensions are constant background risks.

segments.src: - **Concentration:** The industry depends on a small number of suppliers for its most advanced chips, which makes disruptions especially consequential.

segments.src: ## Why TSMC sits at the center of the AI story
segments.tr: ## TSMC AI कहानी के केंद्र में क्यों है

segments.src: TSMC is a *foundry*: it manufactures chips designed by other companies rather than selling chips under its own brand.
segments.tr: TSMC एक *फाउंड्री* है: यह अपने खुद के ब्रांड के तहत चिप्स बेचने के बजाय अन्य कंपनियों द्वारा डिज़ाइन किए गए चिप्स का निर्माण करती है।

segments.src: Many of the leading designers of AI accelerators, data center processors and smartphone chips rely on it to turn their designs into silicon, particularly at the most advanced manufacturing nodes.
segments.tr: AI एक्सीलेरेटर, डेटा सेंटर प्रोसेसर और स्मार्टफोन चिप्स के कई प्रमुख डिज़ाइनर अपने डिज़ाइन को सिलिकॉन में बदलने के लिए इस पर निर्भर करते हैं, विशेष रूप से सबसे उन्नत निर्माण नोड्स पर।

segments.src: That position creates an unusual vantage point.
segments.tr: वह स्थिति एक असामान्य दृष्टिकोण बनाती है।

segments.src: When cloud providers and AI developers plan to buy more computing power, the orders eventually flow down the supply chain to the factories that build the chips.
segments.tr: जब क्लाउड प्रदाता और AI डेवलपर्स अधिक कंप्यूटिंग पावर खरीदने की योजना बनाते हैं, तो ऑर्डर अंततः आपूर्ति श्रृंखला से नीचे उन कारखानों तक पहुँचते हैं जो चिप्स बनाते हैं।

segments.src: TSMC sees that demand before it shows up in many customers' own financial statements.
segments.tr: TSMC उस मांग को कई ग्राहकों के अपने वित्तीय विवरणों में दिखाई देने से पहले ही देख लेता है।

segments.src: In other words, the company works as a kind of scoreboard.
segments.tr: दूसरे शब्दों में, कंपनी एक प्रकार के स्कोरबोर्ड के रूप में काम करती है।

segments.src: It does not pick winners among AI software firms or chip designers, but it reflects how much total capacity the industry is trying to build.
segments.tr: यह AI सॉफ्टवेयर फर्मों या चिप डिजाइनरों के बीच विजेताओं का चयन नहीं करती है, बल्कि यह दर्शाती है कि उद्योग कुल कितनी क्षमता का निर्माण करने का प्रयास कर रहा है।

segments.src: ## What investors and analysts will be watching
segments.tr: ## निवेशक और विश्लेषक क्या देखेंगे

segments.src: ### 1. Revenue mix: AI versus everything else
segments.tr: ### 1. राजस्व मिश्रण: AI बनाम बाकी सब कुछ

segments.src: TSMC breaks out revenue by platform, including high-performance computing, smartphones, automotive and Internet of Things.
segments.tr: TSMC उच्च-प्रदर्शन कंप्यूटिंग, स्मार्टफोन, ऑटोमोटिव और इंटरनेट ऑफ थिंग्स सहित प्लेटफॉर्म द्वारा राजस्व को विभाजित करती है।

segments.src: The high-performance computing category is the one most closely tied to AI.
segments.tr: उच्च-प्रदर्शन कंप्यूटिंग श्रेणी AI से सबसे अधिक निकटता से जुड़ी हुई है।

segments.src: Analysts will watch how fast it is growing, and whether it keeps taking a larger share of the total.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक यह देखेंगे कि यह कितनी तेजी से बढ़ रही है, और क्या यह कुल हिस्से का एक बड़ा हिस्सा लेना जारी रखती है।

segments.src: ### 2. Guidance for the next quarter
segments.tr: ### 2. अगली तिमाही के लिए मार्गदर्शन

segments.src: Results describe the past; guidance describes what management expects next.
segments.tr: परिणाम अतीत का वर्णन करते हैं; मार्गदर्शन वर्णन करता है कि प्रबंधन आगे क्या उम्मीद करता है।

segments.src: A forward revenue range and margin outlook often move markets more than the quarter that just ended.
segments.tr: आगे का राजस्व दायरा और मार्جिन दृष्टिकोण अक्सर समाप्त हुई तिमाही की तुलना में बाजारों को अधिक प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: A confident outlook suggests customers are still placing firm orders, while a cautious tone could signal that buyers are digesting earlier purchases.

segments.src: ### 3. Capital spending plans
segments.tr: ### 3. पूंजीगत खर्च योजनाएं

segments.src: TSMC spends heavily on new factories and equipment, and its capital expenditure plans are a bet on future demand.
segments.tr: TSMC नए कारखानों और उपकरणों पर भारी खर्च करती है, और इसकी पूंजीगत व्यय योजनाएं भविष्य की मांग पर एक दांव हैं।

segments.src: Raising the budget implies management sees durable growth.

segments.src: Trimming it would be read as a sign of caution.
segments.tr: इसे काटना सावधानी के संकेत के रूप में पढ़ा जाएगा।

segments.src: Either way, the change also ripples through equipment makers and other suppliers.
segments.tr: किसी भी तरह, यह बदलाव उपकरण निर्माताओं और अन्य आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के बीच भी गूंजता है।

segments.src: ### 4. Advanced packaging capacity
segments.tr: ### 4. उन्नत पैकेजिंग क्षमता

segments.src: For AI chips, the bottleneck has not been only the silicon itself.
segments.tr: AI चिप्स के लिए, अड़चन केवल सिलिकॉन ही नहीं रही है।

segments.src: Advanced packaging, the process of combining processors and high-bandwidth memory into a single module, has been a limiting factor.
segments.tr: उन्नत पैकेजिंग, प्रोसेसर और उच्च-बैंडविड्थ मेमोरी को एक ही मॉड्यूल में संयोजित करने की प्रक्रिया, एक सीमित कारक रही है।

segments.src: Commentary on how quickly that capacity is expanding helps explain how much supply can reach the market.
segments.tr: यह क्षमता कितनी तेजी से बढ़ रही है, इस पर टिप्पणी यह समझाने में मदद करती है कि बाजार में कितनी आपूर्ति पहुँच सकती है।

segments.src: ### 5. Margins and costs
segments.tr: ### 5. मार्जिन और लागत

segments.tr: अत्याधुनिक कारखाने बनाना महंगा है, और विदेशों में विस्तार से लागत बढ़ती है।

segments.src: Foundry orders can run ahead of actual consumption, and customers sometimes build inventory.

segments.tr: ## जोखिम जो आय विवरण के बाहर हैं

es.title: Resultados de TSMC esta semana: Por qué este fabricante de chips taiwanés es el marcador del auge de la IA

segments.src: Few corporate earnings reports are read as closely outside their own industry as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.
segments.tr: Pocos informes de ganancias corporativas se leen con tanta atención fuera de su propia industria como el de Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.

segments.src: (TSMC).
segments.tr: (TSMC).

segments.src: The company makes the advanced processors that power many of the world's largest AI data centers, which makes its quarterly results one of the most useful windows into whether AI spending is still speeding up, leveling off, or cooling.
segments.tr: La empresa fabrica los procesadores avanzados que impulsan muchos de los centros de datos de IA más grandes del mundo, lo que convierte sus resultados trimestrales en una de las ventanas más útiles para saber si el gasto en IA sigue acelerándose, estabilizándose o enfriándose.

segments.src: This week's report arrives after several weeks of choppy trading in technology stocks.
segments.tr: El informe de esta semana llega tras varias semanas de operaciones inestables en las acciones tecnológicas.

segments.src: Here is what to look for, and why it matters beyond a single company.
segments.tr: Aquí le mostramos qué buscar y por qué es importante más allá de una sola empresa.

segments.src: ## Why TSMC sits at the center of the AI story
segments.tr: ## Por qué TSMC se sitúa en el centro de la historia de la IA

segments.src: TSMC is a *foundry*: it manufactures chips designed by other companies rather than selling chips under its own brand.
segments.tr: TSMC es una *fundición*: fabrica chips diseñados por otras empresas en lugar de vender chips bajo su propia marca.

segments.src: Many of the leading designers of AI accelerators, data center processors and smartphone chips rely on it to turn their designs into silicon, particularly at the most advanced manufacturing nodes.
segments.tr: Muchos de los principales diseñadores de aceleradores de IA, procesadores de centros de datos y chips para teléfonos inteligentes dependen de ella para convertir sus diseños en silicio, particularmente en los nodos de fabricación más avanzados.

segments.src: That position creates an unusual vantage point.
segments.tr: Esa posición crea un punto de vista inusual.

segments.src: When cloud providers and AI developers plan to buy more computing power, the orders eventually flow down the supply chain to the factories that build the chips.
segments.tr: Cuando los proveedores de la nube y los desarrolladores de IA planean comprar más potencia informática, los pedidos fluyen finalmente por la cadena de suministro hasta las fábricas que construyen los chips.

segments.src: TSMC sees that demand before it shows up in many customers' own financial statements.
segments.tr: TSMC ve esa demanda antes de que aparezca en los estados financieros de muchos de sus propios clientes.

segments.src: In other words, the company works as a kind of scoreboard.
segments.tr: En otras palabras, la empresa funciona como una especie de marcador.

segments.src: It does not pick winners among AI software firms or chip designers, but it reflects how much total capacity the industry is trying to build.
segments.tr: No elige ganadores entre las empresas de software de IA o los diseñadores de chips, pero refleja cuánta capacidad total está intentando construir la industria.

segments.src: ## What investors and analysts will be watching
segments.tr: ## Qué observarán los inversores y analistas

segments.src: ### 1. Revenue mix: AI versus everything else
segments.tr: ### 1. Mezcla de ingresos: IA frente a todo lo demás

segments.src: TSMC breaks out revenue by platform, including high-performance computing, smartphones, automotive and Internet of Things.
segments.tr: TSMC desglosa los ingresos por plataforma, incluyendo computación de alto rendimiento, teléfonos inteligentes, automoción e Internet de las cosas.

segments.src: The high-performance computing category is the one most closely tied to AI.
segments.tr: La categoría de computación de alto rendimiento es la más estrechamente vinculada a la IA.

segments.src: Analysts will watch how fast it is growing, and whether it keeps taking a larger share of the total.
segments.tr: Los analistas observarán qué tan rápido está creciendo y si sigue ocupando una mayor parte del total.

segments.src: ### 2. Guidance for the next quarter
segments.tr: ### 2. Orientación para el próximo trimestre

segments.src: Results describe the past; guidance describes what management expects next.
segments.tr: Los resultados describen el pasado; la orientación describe lo que la dirección espera a continuación.

segments.src: A forward revenue range and margin outlook often move markets more than the quarter that just ended.
segments.tr: Un rango de ingresos futuros y una perspectiva de margen a menudo mueven los mercados más que el trimestre que acaba de terminar.

segments.src: A confident outlook suggests customers are still placing firm orders, while a cautious tone could signal that buyers are digesting earlier purchases.
segments.tr: Una perspectiva confiada sugiere que los clientes siguen realizando pedidos firmes, mientras que un tono cauteloso podría indicar que los compradores están digiriendo compras anteriores.

segments.src: ### 3. Capital spending plans
segments.tr: ### 3. Planes de gasto de capital

segments.src: TSMC spends heavily on new factories and equipment, and its capital expenditure plans are a bet on future demand.
segments.tr: TSMC gasta mucho en nuevas fábricas y equipos, y sus planes de gasto de capital son una apuesta por la demanda futura.

segments.src: Raising the budget implies management sees durable growth.
segments.tr: Aumentar el presupuesto implica que la dirección ve un crecimiento duradero.

segments.src: Trimming it would be read as a sign of caution.
segments.tr: Recortarlo se leería como una señal de precaución.

segments.src: Either way, the change also ripples through equipment makers and other suppliers.
segments.tr: De cualquier manera, el cambio también repercute en los fabricantes de equipos y otros proveedores.

segments.src: ### 4. Advanced packaging capacity
segments.tr: ### 4. Capacidad de empaquetado avanzado

segments.src: For AI chips, the bottleneck has not been only the silicon itself.
segments.tr: Para los chips de IA, el cuello de botella no ha sido solo el silicio en sí.

segments.src: Advanced packaging, the process of combining processors and high-bandwidth memory into a single module, has been a limiting factor.
segments.tr: El empaquetado avanzado, el proceso de combinar procesadores y memoria de gran ancho de banda en un solo módulo, ha sido un factor limitante.

segments.src: Commentary on how quickly that capacity is expanding helps explain how much supply can reach the market.
segments.tr: Los comentarios sobre qué tan rápido se está expandiendo esa capacidad ayudan a explicar cuánto suministro puede llegar al mercado.

segments.src: ### 5. Margins and costs
segments.tr: ### 5. Márgenes y costos

segments.src: Building cutting-edge factories is expensive, and overseas expansion adds cost.
segments.tr: Construir fábricas de vanguardia es costoso, y la expansión en el extranjero añade costos.

segments.src: Gross margin trends show whether TSMC can maintain pricing strength while absorbing those expenses, as well as the effect of currency movements, since it reports in Taiwan dollars while many of its sales are priced in U.S.
segments.tr: Las tendencias del margen bruto muestran si TSMC puede mantener la fortaleza de precios mientras absorbe esos gastos, así como el efecto de los movimientos cambiarios, ya que informa en dólares taiwaneses mientras que muchas de sus ventas tienen precios en EE.

segments.src: dollars.
segments.tr: UU.

segments.src: ## Reading the results in context
segments.tr: ## Leer los resultados en contexto

segments.src: After a period of sharp swings on Wall Street, a single report will not settle the debate over whether AI spending is sustainable.
segments.tr: Tras un período de fuertes oscilaciones en Wall Street, un solo informe no resolverá el debate sobre si el gasto en IA es sostenible.

segments.src: Still, it can supply useful evidence for several questions:
segments.tr: Aun así, puede proporcionar evidencia útil para varias preguntas:

segments.src: - **Is demand broad or narrow?** Strength concentrated in a few customers carries different implications than growth spread across many.
segments.tr: - **¿Es la demanda amplia o estrecha?** La fortaleza concentrada en unos pocos clientes conlleva implicaciones diferentes que el crecimiento repartido entre muchos.

segments.src: - **Is supply catching up?** If capacity is expanding fast enough, the shortage that supported pricing may ease.
segments.tr: - **¿Se está poniendo al día la oferta?** Si la capacidad se está expandiendo lo suficientemente rápido, la escasez que respaldaba los precios podría disminuir.

segments.src: - **Is spending turning into revenue downstream?** TSMC's customers ultimately need end users and businesses willing to pay for AI services. Chip orders are only sustainable if that demand materializes.
segments.tr: - **¿Se está convirtiendo el gasto en ingresos aguas abajo?** Los clientes de TSMC necesitan en última instancia usuarios finales y empresas dispuestas a pagar por los servicios de IA. Los pedidos de chips solo son sostenibles si esa demanda se materializa.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering the limits of the signal.
segments.tr: También vale la pena recordar los límites de la señal.

segments.src: Foundry orders can run ahead of actual consumption, and customers sometimes build inventory.
segments.tr: Los pedidos de fundición pueden adelantarse al consumo real, y los clientes a veces acumulan inventario.

segments.src: A strong quarter does not guarantee the following one, and a soft guide does not necessarily mean a trend has reversed.
segments.tr: Un trimestre fuerte no garantiza el siguiente, y una guía suave no significa necesariamente que una tendencia se haya revertido.

segments.src: ## Risks that sit outside the income statement
segments.tr: ## Riesgos que se sitúan fuera del estado de resultados

segments.src: Several factors beyond quarterly numbers shape how the market interprets the company:
segments.tr: Varios factores más allá de las cifras trimestrales moldean cómo el mercado interpreta a la empresa:

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Taiwan's location and the strategic importance of chips mean trade policy, export controls and regional tensions are constant background risks.
segments.tr: - **Geopolítica:** La ubicación de Taiwán y la importancia estratégica de los chips significan que la política comercial, los controles de exportación y las tensiones regionales son riesgos de fondo constantes.

segments.src: - **Concentration:** The industry depends on a small number of suppliers for its most advanced chips, which makes disruptions especially consequential.
segments.tr: - **Concentración:** La industria depende de un pequeño número de proveedores para sus chips más avanzados, lo que hace que las interrupciones sean especialmente trascendentales.

segments.src: - **Valuation:** When expectations are high, even good results can be met with selling if they fall short of the most optimistic forecasts.
segments.tr: - **Valoración:** Cuando las expectativas son altas, incluso los buenos resultados pueden ser recibidos con ventas si no alcanzan los pronósticos más optimistas.

segments.src: ## The takeaway
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: TSMC's report is not a verdict on every company riding the AI wave, but it is among the most direct readings of how much real manufacturing activity sits behind the headlines.
segments.tr: El informe de TSMC no es un veredicto sobre cada empresa que se sube a la ola de la IA, pero es una de las lecturas más directas de cuánta actividad de fabricación real hay detrás de los titulares.

segments.src: Pay attention to the guidance, the capital spending outlook and the language around demand and capacity.
segments.tr: Preste atención a la orientación, la perspectiva de gasto de capital y el lenguaje en torno a la demanda y la capacidad.

segments.src: Together they offer a grounded view of whether the AI buildout is still gathering pace.
segments.tr: Juntos ofrecen una visión fundamentada de si el desarrollo de la IA sigue ganando ritmo.

fr.title: Rapports de TSMC cette semaine : pourquoi un fondeur taïwanais de puces est le tableau d'affichage du boom de l'IA

segments.src: Few corporate earnings reports are read as closely outside their own industry as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.
segments.tr: Peu de rapports de résultats d'entreprise sont lus aussi attentivement en dehors de leur propre secteur que Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.

segments.src: (TSMC).
segments.tr: (TSMC).

segments.src: The company makes the advanced processors that power many of the world's largest AI data centers, which makes its quarterly results one of the most useful windows into whether AI spending is still speeding up, leveling off, or cooling.
segments.tr: L'entreprise fabrique les processeurs avancés qui alimentent nombre des plus grands centres de données d'IA au monde, ce qui fait de ses résultats trimestriels l'une des fenêtres les plus utiles pour savoir si les dépenses en IA continuent d'accélérer, se stabilisent ou se refroidissent.

segments.src: This week's report arrives after several weeks of choppy trading in technology stocks.
segments.tr: Le rapport de cette semaine arrive après plusieurs semaines de transactions agitées dans les actions technologiques.

segments.src: Here is what to look for, and why it matters beyond a single company.
segments.tr: Voici ce qu'il faut surveiller et pourquoi cela compte au-delà d'une seule entreprise.

segments.src: ## Why TSMC sits at the center of the AI story
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi TSMC se trouve au centre de l'histoire de l'IA

segments.src: TSMC is a *foundry*: it manufactures chips designed by other companies rather than selling chips under its own brand.
segments.tr: TSMC est un *fondeur* : il fabrique des puces conçues par d'autres entreprises plutôt de vendre des puces sous sa propre marque.

segments.src: Many of the leading designers of AI accelerators, data center processors and smartphone chips rely on it to turn their designs into silicon, particularly at the most advanced manufacturing nodes.
segments.tr: Nombre des principaux concepteurs d'accélérateurs d'IA, de processeurs de centres de données et de puces de smartphones comptent sur lui pour transformer leurs conceptions en silicium, en particulier aux nœuds de fabrication les plus avancés.

segments.src: That position creates an unusual vantage point.
segments.tr: Cette position crée un point de vue inhabituel.

segments.src: When cloud providers and AI developers plan to buy more computing power, the orders eventually flow down the supply chain to the factories that build the chips.
segments.tr: Lorsque les fournisseurs de cloud et les développeurs d'IA prévoient d'acheter plus de puissance de calcul, les commandes descendent finalement la chaîne d'approvisionnement vers les usines qui construisent les puces.

segments.src: TSMC sees that demand before it shows up in many customers' own financial statements.
segments.tr: TSMC voit cette demande avant qu'elle n'apparaisse dans les propres états financiers de nombreux clients.

segments.src: In other words, the company works as a kind of scoreboard.
segments.tr: En d'autres termes, l'entreprise fonctionne comme une sorte de tableau d'affichage.

segments.src: It does not pick winners among AI software firms or chip designers, but it reflects how much total capacity the industry is trying to build.
segments.tr: Elle ne choisit pas de gagnants parmi les entreprises de logiciels d'IA ou les concepteurs de puces, mais elle reflète la capacité totale que l'industrie essaie de construire.

segments.src: ## What investors and analysts will be watching
segments.tr: ## Ce que les investisseurs et les analystes surveilleront

segments.src: ### 1. Revenue mix: AI versus everything else
segments.tr: ### 1. Mix de revenus : l'IA par rapport à tout le reste

segments.src: TSMC breaks out revenue by platform, including high-performance computing, smartphones, automotive and Internet of Things.
segments.tr: TSMC détaille ses revenus par plateforme, y compris le calcul haute performance, les smartphones, l'automobile et l'Internet des objets.

segments.src: The high-performance computing category is the one most closely tied to AI.
segments.tr: La catégorie du calcul haute performance est celle qui est le plus étroitement liée à l'IA.

segments.src: Analysts will watch how fast it is growing, and whether it keeps taking a larger share of the total.
segments.tr: Les analystes observeront à quelle vitesse elle croît et si elle continue de prendre une part plus importante du total.

segments.src: ### 2. Guidance for the next quarter
segments.tr: ### 2. Prévisions pour le trimestre prochain

segments.src: Results describe the past; guidance describes what management expects next.
segments.tr: Les résultats décrivent le passé ; les prévisions décrivent ce que la direction attend ensuite.

segments.src: A forward revenue range and margin outlook often move markets more than the quarter that just ended.
segments.tr: Une fourchette de revenus futurs et des perspectives de marge déplacent souvent les marchés plus que le trimestre qui vient de s'achever.

segments.src: A confident outlook suggests customers are still placing firm orders, while a cautious tone could signal that buyers are digesting earlier purchases.
segments.tr: Des perspectives confiantes suggèrent que les clients passent toujours des commandes fermes, tandis qu'un ton prudent pourrait signaler que les acheteurs digèrent les achats précédents.

segments.src: ### 3. Capital spending plans
segments.tr: ### 3. Plans de dépenses en capital

segments.src: TSMC spends heavily on new factories and equipment, and its capital expenditure plans are a bet on future demand.
segments.tr: TSMC dépense massivement en nouvelles usines et équipements, et ses plans de dépenses en capital sont un pari sur la demande future.

segments.src: Raising the budget implies management sees durable growth.
segments.tr: Augmenter le budget implique que la direction voit une croissance durable.

segments.src: Trimming it would be read as a sign of caution.
segments.tr: Le réduire serait interprété comme un signe de prudence.

segments.src: Either way, the change also ripples through equipment makers and other suppliers.
segments.tr: Quoi qu'il en soit, le changement se répercute également sur les fabricants d'équipements et d'autres fournisseurs.

segments.src: ### 4. Advanced packaging capacity
segments.tr: ### 4. Capacité d'emballage avancé

segments.src: For AI chips, the bottleneck has not been only the silicon itself.
segments.tr: Pour les puces d'IA, le goulot d'étranglement n'a pas seulement été le silicium lui-même.

segments.src: Advanced packaging, the process of combining processors and high-bandwidth memory into a single module, has been a limiting factor.
segments.tr: L'emballage avancé, le processus combinant des processeurs et une mémoire à large bande dans un seul module, a été un facteur limitant.

segments.src: Commentary on how quickly that capacity is expanding helps explain how much supply can reach the market.
segments.tr: Les commentaires sur la rapidité avec laquelle cette capacité s'étend aident à expliquer quelle quantité d'offre peut atteindre le marché.

segments.src: ### 5. Margins and costs
segments.tr: ### 5. Marges et coûts

segments.src: Building cutting-edge factories is expensive, and overseas expansion adds cost.
segments.tr: Construire des usines de pointe est coûteux, et l'expansion à l'étranger ajoute des coûts.

segments.src: Gross margin trends show whether TSMC can maintain pricing strength while absorbing those expenses, as well as the effect of currency movements, since it reports in Taiwan dollars while many of its sales are priced in U.S.
segments.tr: Les tendances des marges brutes montrent si TSMC peut maintenir sa force de tarification tout en absorbant ces dépenses, ainsi que l'effet des mouvements de change, puisqu'il rapporte en dollars taïwanais tandis qu'une grande partie de ses ventes est tarifée en dollars des É.-U.

## Reading the results in context
segments.tr: ## Lire les résultats dans leur contexte

segments.src: After a period of sharp swings on Wall Street, a single report will not settle the debate over whether AI spending is sustainable.
segments.tr: Après une période de fortes fluctuations à Wall Street, un seul rapport ne réglera pas le débat sur la durabilité des dépenses en IA.

segments.src: Still, it can supply useful evidence for several questions:
segments.tr: Néanmoins, il peut fournir des preuves utiles pour plusieurs questions :

segments.src: - **Is demand broad or narrow?** Strength concentrated in a few customers carries different implications than growth spread across many.
segments.tr: - **La demande est-elle large ou étroite ?** Une force concentrée chez quelques clients comporte des implications différentes d'une croissance répartie sur un grand nombre.

segments.src: - **Is supply catching up?** If capacity is expanding fast enough, the shortage that supported pricing may ease.
segments.tr: - **L'offre rattrape-t-elle son retard ?** Si la capacité s'étend assez rapidement, la pénurie qui a soutenu les prix pourrait s'atténuer.

segments.src: - **Is spending turning into revenue downstream?** TSMC's customers ultimately need end users and businesses willing to pay for AI services. Chip orders are only sustainable if that demand materializes.
segments.tr: - **Les dépenses se transforment-elles en revenus en aval ?** Les clients de TSMC ont finalement besoin d'utilisateurs finaux et d'entreprises disposés à payer pour des services d'IA. Les commandes de puces ne sont durables que si cette demande se matérialise.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering the limits of the signal.
segments.tr: Il est également utile de se rappeler les limites du signal.

segments.src: Foundry orders can run ahead of actual consumption, and customers sometimes build inventory.
segments.tr: Les commandes de fonderie peuvent devancer la consommation réelle, et les clients constituent parfois des stocks.

segments.src: A strong quarter does not guarantee the following one, and a soft guide does not necessarily mean a trend has reversed.
segments.tr: Un trimestre fort ne garantit pas le suivant, et un guide faible ne signifie pas nécessairement qu'une tendance s'est inversée.

segments.src: ## Risks that sit outside the income statement
segments.tr: ## Risques situés en dehors du compte de résultat

segments.src: Several factors beyond quarterly numbers shape how the market interprets the company:
segments.tr: Plusieurs facteurs au-delà des chiffres trimestriels façonnent la façon dont le marché interprète l'entreprise :

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Taiwan's location and the strategic importance of chips mean trade policy, export controls and regional tensions are constant background risks.
segments.tr: - **Géopolitique :** L'emplacement de Taïwan et l'importance stratégique des puces signifient que la politique commerciale, les contrôles à l'exportation et les tensions régionales sont des risques de fond constants.

segments.src: - **Concentration:** The industry depends on a small number of suppliers for its most advanced chips, which makes disruptions especially consequential.
segments.tr: - **Concentration :** L'industrie dépend d'un petit nombre de fournisseurs pour ses puces les plus avancées, ce qui rend les perturbations particulièrement lourdes de conséquences.

segments.src: - **Valuation:** When expectations are high, even good results can be met with selling if they fall short of the most optimistic forecasts.
segments.tr: - **Valorisation :** Lorsque les attentes sont élevées, de bons résultats eux-mêmes peuvent être accueillis par des ventes s'ils tombent en deçà des prévisions les plus optimistes.

segments.src: ## The takeaway
segments.tr: ## À retenir

segments.tr: Le rapport de TSMC n'est pas un verdict sur chaque entreprise surfant sur la vague de l'IA, mais il est l'une des lectures les plus directes de l'activité manufacturière réelle qui se cache derrière les gros titres.

segments.tr: Prêtez attention aux prévisions, aux perspectives de dépenses en capital et au langage autour de la demande et de la capacité.

segments.src: Together they offer a grounded view of whether the AI buildout is still gathering pace.

segments.src: ## Why TSMC sits at the center of the AI story

segments.src: Many of the leading designers of AI accelerators, data center processors and smartphone chips rely on it to turn their designs into silicon, particularly at the most advanced manufacturing nodes.
segments.tr: Banyak perancang terkemuka akselerator AI, prosesor pusat data, dan chip telepon pintar mengandalkan perusahaan ini untuk mengubah desain mereka menjadi silikon, terutama pada simpul manufaktur yang paling canggih.

segments.src: That position creates an unusual vantage point.
segments.tr: Posisi tersebut menciptakan sudut pandang yang tidak biasa.

segments.src: When cloud providers and AI developers plan to buy more computing power, the orders eventually flow down the supply chain to the factories that build the chips.

segments.src: TSMC sees that demand before it shows up in many customers' own financial statements.

segments.src: ### 3. Capital spending plans

segments.src: Few corporate earnings reports are read as closely outside their own industry as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.

segments.src: (TSMC).
segments.tr: (TSMC).

segments.src: The company makes the advanced processors that power many of the world's largest AI data centers, which makes its quarterly results one of the most useful windows into whether AI spending is still speeding up, leveling off, or cooling.
segments.tr: Das Unternehmen stellt die fortschrittlichen Prozessoren her, die viele der weltweit größten KI-Rechenzentren antreiben. Das macht seine Quartalsergebnisse zu einem der nützlichsten Indikatoren dafür, ob sich die KI-Ausgaben weiter beschleunigen, einvielen oder abkühlen.

segments.src: This week's report arrives after several weeks of choppy trading in technology stocks.
segments.tr: Der Bericht dieser Woche kommt nach mehreren Wochen schwankenden Handels bei Technologiewerten.

segments.src: Here is what to look for, and why it matters beyond a single company.
segments.tr: Hier ist, worauf zu achten ist und warum es über ein einzelnes Unternehmen hinaus wichtig ist.

segments.src: ## Why TSMC sits at the center of the AI story
segments.tr: ## Warum TSMC im Zentrum der KI-Geschichte steht

segments.src: TSMC is a *foundry*: it manufactures chips designed by other companies rather than selling chips under its own brand.
segments.tr: TSMC ist eine *Foundry*: Das Unternehmen fertigt Chips, die von anderen Firmen entworfen wurden, anstatt Chips unter seiner eigenen Marke zu verkaufen.

segments.src: Many of the leading designers of AI accelerators, data center processors and smartphone chips rely on it to turn their designs into silicon, particularly at the most advanced manufacturing nodes.
segments.tr: Viele der führenden Entwickler von KI-Beschleunigern, Rechenzentrumsprozessoren und Smartphone-Chips verlassen sich darauf, dass TSMC ihre Designs in Silizium umsetzt, insbesondere bei den fortschrittlichsten Fertigungsknoten.

segments.src: That position creates an unusual vantage point.
segments.tr: Diese Position schafft eine ungewöhnliche Perspektive.

segments.src: When cloud providers and AI developers plan to buy more computing power, the orders eventually flow down the supply chain to the factories that build the chips.
segments.tr: Wenn Cloud-Anbieter und KI-Entwickler planen, mehr Rechenleistung zu kaufen, fließen die Aufträge schließlich die Lieferkette hinunter zu den Fabriken, die die Chips bauen.

segments.src: TSMC sees that demand before it shows up in many customers' own financial statements.
segments.tr: TSMC sieht diese Nachfrage, bevor sie in den Finanzberichten vieler Kunden auftaucht.

segments.src: In other words, the company works as a kind of scoreboard.
segments.tr: Mit anderen Worten, das Unternehmen fungiert als eine Art Anzeigetafel.

segments.src: It does not pick winners among AI software firms or chip designers, but it reflects how much total capacity the industry is trying to build.
segments.tr: Es wählt keine Gewinner unter KI-Softwarefirmen oder Chip-Designern aus, spiegelt aber wider, wie viel Gesamtkapazität die Branche aufzubauen versucht.

segments.src: ## What investors and analysts will be watching
segments.tr: ## Worauf Investoren und Analysten achten werden

segments.src: ### 1. Revenue mix: AI versus everything else
segments.tr: ### 1. Umsatzmix: KI versus alles andere

segments.src: TSMC breaks out revenue by platform, including high-performance computing, smartphones, automotive and Internet of Things.
segments.tr: TSMC schlüsselt den Umsatz nach Plattformen auf, darunter Hochleistungsrechnen, Smartphones, Automobil und das Internet der Dinge.

segments.src: The high-performance computing category is the one most closely tied to AI.
segments.tr: Die Kategorie des Hochleistungsrechnens ist diejenige, die am engsten mit KI verbunden ist.

segments.src: Analysts will watch how fast it is growing, and whether it keeps taking a larger share of the total.
segments.tr: Analysten werden beobachten, wie schnell sie wächst und ob sie weiterhin einen größeren Anteil am Gesamtwert einnimmt.

segments.src: ### 2. Guidance for the next quarter
segments.tr: ### 2. Prognose für das nächste Quartal

segments.src: Results describe the past; guidance describes what management expects next.
segments.tr: Ergebnisse beschreiben die Vergangenheit; Prognosen beschreiben, was das Management als Nächstes erwartet.

segments.src: A forward revenue range and margin outlook often move markets more than the quarter that just ended.
segments.tr: Eine zukünftige Umsatzspanne und der Margenausblick bewegen die Märkte oft stärker als das gerade abgelaufene Quartal.

segments.src: A confident outlook suggests customers are still placing firm orders, while a cautious tone could signal that buyers are digesting earlier purchases.
segments.tr: Ein zuversichtlicher Ausblick deutet darauf hin, dass Kunden weiterhin feste Aufträge erteilen, während ein vorsichtiger Ton signalisieren könnte, dass Käufer frühere Käufe verarbeiten.

segments.src: ### 3. Capital spending plans
segments.tr: ### 3. Investitionspläne

segments.src: TSMC spends heavily on new factories and equipment, and its capital expenditure plans are a bet on future demand.
segments.tr: TSMC gibt viel Geld für neue Fabriken und Ausrüstung aus, und seine Investitionspläne sind eine Wette auf die zukünftige Nachfrage.

segments.src: Raising the budget implies management sees durable growth.
segments.tr: Eine Erhöhung des Budgets bedeutet, dass das Management ein nachhaltiges Wachstum sieht.

segments.src: Trimming it would be read as a sign of caution.
segments.tr: Eine Kürzung würde als Zeichen der Vorsicht gewertet.

segments.src: Either way, the change also ripples through equipment makers and other suppliers.
segments.tr: In jedem Fall wirkt sich die Änderung auch auf Ausrüstungshersteller und andere Lieferanten aus.

segments.src: ### 4. Advanced packaging capacity
segments.tr: ### 4. Kapazität für fortgeschrittene Verpackung

segments.src: For AI chips, the bottleneck has not been only the silicon itself.
segments.tr: Bei KI-Chips war der Engpass nicht nur das Silizium selbst.

segments.src: Advanced packaging, the process of combining processors and high-bandwidth memory into a single module, has been a limiting factor.
segments.tr: Fortschrittliche Verpackungen, der Prozess der Kombination von Prozessoren und High-Bandwidth-Memory in einem einzigen Modul, waren ein limitierender Faktor.

segments.src: Commentary on how quickly that capacity is expanding helps explain how much supply can reach the market.
segments.tr: Kommentare darüber, wie schnell diese Kapazität wächst, helfen zu erklären, wie viel Angebot den Markt erreichen kann.

segments.src: ### 5. Margins and costs
segments.tr: ### 5. Margen und Kosten

segments.src: Building cutting-edge factories is expensive, and overseas expansion adds cost.
segments.tr: Der Bau modernster Fabriken ist teuer, und die Expansion ins Ausland erhöht die Kosten.

segments.src: Gross margin trends show whether TSMC can maintain pricing strength while absorbing those expenses, as well as the effect of currency movements, since it reports in Taiwan dollars while many of its sales are priced in U.S.
segments.tr: Bruttomargentrends zeigen, ob TSMC seine Preismacht bei der Absorption dieser Ausgaben beibehalten kann, sowie die Auswirkungen von Währungsschwankungen, da das Unternehmen in taiwanesischen Dollar berichtet, während viele seiner Verkäufe in den USA gepreist sind.

segments.src: Commentary on how quickly that capacity is expanding helps explain how much supply can reach the market.
segments.tr: Bình luận về tốc độ mở rộng công suất đó giúp giải thích có bao nhiêu nguồn cung có thể tiếp cận thị trường.

segments.src: ### 5. Margins and costs
segments.tr: ### 5. Biên lợi nhuận và chi phí

segments.src: Building cutting-edge factories is expensive, and overseas expansion adds cost.
segments.tr: Xây dựng các nhà máy tiên tiến rất đắt đỏ, và việc mở rộng ra nước ngoài làm tăng chi phí.

segments.src: Gross margin trends show whether TSMC can maintain pricing strength while absorbing those expenses, as well as the effect of currency movements, since it reports in Taiwan dollars while many of its sales are priced in U.S.
segments.tr: Xu hướng biên lợi nhuận gộp cho thấy liệu TSMC có thể duy trì sức mạnh định giá trong khi hấp thụ các chi phí đó hay không, cũng như ảnh hưởng của biến động tiền tệ, vì họ báo cáo bằng đô la Đài Loan trong khi nhiều doanh số bán hàng của họ được định giá bằng U.S.

segments.src: ## Reading the results in context
segments.tr: ## Đọc kết quả trong bối cảnh

segments.src: After a period of sharp swings on Wall Street, a single report will not settle the debate over whether AI spending is sustainable.
segments.tr: Sau một thời gian biến động mạnh trên Phố Wall, một báo cáo duy nhất sẽ không giải quyết cuộc tranh luận về việc liệu chi tiêu cho AI có bền vững hay không.

segments.src: Still, it can supply useful evidence for several questions:
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, nó có thể cung cấp bằng chứng hữu ích cho một số câu hỏi:

segments.src: - **Is demand broad or narrow?** Strength concentrated in a few customers carries different implications than growth spread across many.
segments.tr: - **Nhu cầu là rộng hay hẹp?** Sức mạnh tập trung ở một vài khách hàng mang lại hàm ý khác với sự tăng trưởng lan rộng ra nhiều khách hàng.

segments.src: - **Is supply catching up?** If capacity is expanding fast enough, the shortage that supported pricing may ease.
segments.tr: - **Nguồn cung có đang bắt kịp không?** Nếu công suất đang mở rộng đủ nhanh, tình trạng thiếu hụt hỗ trợ giá cả có thể dịu đi.

segments.src: - **Is spending turning into revenue downstream?** TSMC's customers ultimately need end users and businesses willing to pay for AI services. Chip orders are only sustainable if that demand materializes.
segments.tr: - **Chi tiêu có đang biến thành doanh thu ở hạ nguồn không?** Khách hàng của TSMC cuối cùng cần người dùng cuối và doanh nghiệp sẵn sàng trả tiền cho các dịch vụ AI. Các đơn đặt hàng chip chỉ bền vững nếu nhu cầu đó thành hiện thực.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering the limits of the signal.
segments.tr: Cũng cần nhớ giới hạn của tín hiệu.

segments.src: Foundry orders can run ahead of actual consumption, and customers sometimes build inventory.
segments.tr: Đơn hàng của xưởng đúc có thể vượt trước mức tiêu thụ thực tế, và đôi khi khách hàng tích lũy hàng tồn kho.

segments.src: A strong quarter does not guarantee the following one, and a soft guide does not necessarily mean a trend has reversed.
segments.tr: Một quý mạnh mẽ không đảm bảo cho quý tiếp theo, và một hướng dẫn yếu không có nghĩa là một xu hướng đã đảo ngược.

segments.src: ## Risks that sit outside the income statement
segments.tr: ## Rủi ro nằm ngoài báo cáo kết quả kinh doanh

segments.src: Several factors beyond quarterly numbers shape how the market interprets the company:
segments.tr: Một số yếu tố ngoài các con số hàng quý định hình cách thị trường diễn giải công ty:

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Taiwan's location and the strategic importance of chips mean trade policy, export controls and regional tensions are constant background risks.
segments.tr: - **Địa chính trị:** Vị trí của Đài Loan và tầm quan trọng chiến lược của chip có nghĩa là chính sách thương mại, kiểm soát xuất khẩu và căng thẳng khu vực là những rủi ro nền tảng liên tục.

segments.src: - **Concentration:** The industry depends on a small number of suppliers for its most advanced chips, which makes disruptions especially consequential.
segments.tr: - **Sự tập trung:** Ngành công nghiệp phụ thuộc vào một số ít nhà cung cấp cho các con chip tiên tiến nhất của mình, điều này làm cho sự gián đoạn trở nên đặc biệt quan trọng.

segments.src: - **Valuation:** When expectations are high, even good results can be met with selling if they fall short of the most optimistic forecasts.
segments.tr: - **Định giá:** Khi kỳ vọng cao, ngay cả kết quả tốt cũng có thể gặp phải tình trạng bán tháo nếu chúng không đạt được các dự báo lạc quan nhất.

segments.src: ## The takeaway
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: TSMC's report is not a verdict on every company riding the AI wave, but it is among the most direct readings of how much real manufacturing activity sits behind the headlines.
segments.tr: Báo cáo của TSMC không phải là phán quyết về mọi công ty đang cưỡi sóng AI, nhưng nó nằm trong số những bài đọc trực tiếp nhất về mức độ hoạt động sản xuất thực tế nằm đằng sau các tiêu đề.

segments.src: Pay attention to the guidance, the capital spending outlook and the language around demand and capacity.
segments.tr: Hãy chú ý đến hướng dẫn, triển vọng chi tiêu vốn và ngôn ngữ xung quanh nhu cầu và công suất.

segments.src: Together they offer a grounded view of whether the AI buildout is still gathering pace.
segments.tr: Cùng nhau, chúng cung cấp một cái nhìn thực tế về việc liệu quá trình xây dựng AI có còn đang tăng tốc hay không.
